game.name: Spec Ops : The Line (Europe)(En,De,It)
game.desc: Spec Ops: The Line for Xbox 360 is a third-person shooter that puts you in the shoes of the leader of a small undercover force tasked with tracking down a US Army colonel. The adventure takes place in the streets of Dubai, which has been totally devastated by powerful natural disasters. The city is now buried in sand and is also a battleground for two armies that don't mean you any harm.
